newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan April WPI rise due to higher sales tax--BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Japan April WPI rise due to higher sales tax--BOJ.

text.p: A rise in Japan's domestic wholesale prices in April was mainly due to the increase in the sales tax, a Bank of Japan (BOJ) official said on Friday.
Japan's national sales tax was raised on April 1 to five percent from three percent.
"There is the effect of the sales tax rise but the trend in Japan prices has not changed and prices continue to be bottoming out," the official said.
Japan's domestic wholesale price index, a key component of the overall WPI, rose 1.9 percent in April from a year earlier and was also up 1.9 percent from the previous month.
